item.title: Baja SAE Business Presentation
item.description: Throughout the year, I joined the new business sub-team for Baja SAE and worked under guidance from the president of Baja Buckeyes and the Formula SAE team’s business lead to develop an RFP document for the business presentation portion of the competition, as well as an oral presentation that placed 10th out of 76 teams at the Oregon Competition.
